summary: Iteration 37 verified end-to-end. Backend (11/11 pytest): POST /api/items accepts subcategory ('Bodysuits'), GET returns it, PUT with {category, subcategory} updates both fields, PUT with subcategory='' clears it, and the cross-category flow (Dresses -> Tops+Bodysuits) persists correctly; GET /api/calendar/config exposes client_secret_fingerprint (10-char) and last_callback_error (null baseline), and /api/calendar/callback returns 200 HTML 'Link expired' for an unknown state and a 'cancelled' page when error param present (no 500s). Frontend: reviewer login OK, /premium no longer mentions 'Capsule wardrobes' and still lists 'Occasion planning', wardrobe renders category+subfilter chip rows, the KEY editor flow works end-to-end (seeded Dresses jumpsuit -> edit -> switch CATEGORY=Tops -> SUBCATEGORY chips refresh to the 12 Tops labels including Bodysuits -> pick 'Bodysuits' -> Save -> item detail badge flips to TOPS -> item now appears under Wardrobe>Tops>Bodysuits and is no longer under Dresses; a follow-up PUT changing subcategory to 'Singlets' correctly persists). Frontend classification 13/13 PASS via UI seed+verify: jumpsuit->Tops>Bodysuits, high-top sneakers->Shoes>Sneakers, wedge sandals->Shoes>Sandals, sweatshirt & hoodie->Outerwear>Jumpers, leather jacket->Outerwear>Jackets, wool blazer->Blazers, cardigan->Cardigans, backpack->Bags>Backpacks (NOT Crossbody), shoulder bag->Handbags, crossbody bag->Crossbody, evening clutch->Clutches, briefcase->Briefcases. No 'Other · N' chip in ANY category. Back-nav preserves category+sub filter (Outerwear>Jumpers) after opening an item and pressing back (scroll page too short to force scroll-restore visibly, but URL/filter kept). Regression smoke: /add-item shows CATEGORY+SUBCATEGORY chip rows and Save button, /bulk-add opens, /dressme prompts for activity (Work/Day off/etc.), Home has Plan Your Week. Taxonomy regexes are Hermes-safe (no lookbehind). All 13 seeded reviewer items deleted after testing.

issues: Item cards show the STORED category label under the name (e.g. 'Tops') even when displayCategory() has re-slotted them into another category chip (e.g. hoodie stored as 'Tops' but shown under Outerwear>Jumpers displays 'Tops' badge). Minor UX inconsistency — presentation label could follow displayCategory(). Not in iteration 37 scope.

react_native_issues.issue: Runtime console warning still emitted on every load: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx (previously flagged in iter36, still present).

action_items: None functional for iteration 37 — all requested behaviours verified.
Optional: move pointerEvents from prop to style.pointerEvents on the onboarding Animated.View to silence the React Native deprecation warning (carried over from iter36).
Optional polish: make item-card sub-label follow displayCategory() rather than raw item.category so hoodies stored as 'Tops' but re-slotted to Outerwear read 'Outerwear' on the card.
critical_code_review_comments: taxonomy.ts is clean, well-commented, uses no Hermes-unsafe lookbehinds and matches SUB_ORDER against SUB_RULES. Regex ordering in SUB_RULES is deliberately most-specific-first for Shoes (Sneakers before Boots, Sandals before Heels) and Bags (Backpacks/Briefcases/Clutches/Crossbody before the generic '\bbag\b' Handbags catch-all) — verified with 13 cases.
add-item.tsx correctly clears subcategory when category changes (line 388) and only renders the SUBCATEGORY chip row when SUB_ORDER[category] exists (line 395) — so Dresses/Jewellery don't show subs.

server.py ItemUpdate.subcategory is Optional[str]=None, but ItemCreate defaults it to '' — that's fine for the 'clear' semantics but two different defaults for the same field is a subtle inconsistency. Not user-visible.
calendar_callback correctly writes GCAL_LAST_ERROR on token exchange failures (surfaces Google's error code on the page); invalid-state and error-param paths never crash, just render an HTML page.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, premium copy, subcategory editor flow, 13/13 classification, no Other chip, back-nav filter preserved, Add/Bulk/DressMe smoke)
